english: Then the sum of all the points of local extremum of $G$ is ______.
hindi: द्वारा परिभाषित है। तब $G$ के सभी स्थानीय चरम बिन्दुओं का योग ______ है।
solution: Minima at $-3,1$; maximum at $-1$ (odd power $5$: sign changes, though $G''(-1)=0$, so the second derivative test fails there)
solution_full: Critical points: $x=-3,-1,1$. Since $e^{u^{2}}>0$, the sign of $G'$ is that of $(x+1)^{5}(x+3)(x-1)$.

First derivative test: local minimum at $x=-3$, local maximum at $x=-1$, local minimum at $x=1$. At $x=-1$ the factor $(x+1)^{5}$ gives $G''(-1)=0$, so the second derivative test is inconclusive there; the first derivative test settles it.
Sum of the points of local extremum $=-3+(-1)+1=-3$.
originality_note: New: the upper limit x^2 + 2x and the double zero of the integrand at t = -1 combine into a fifth-power factor (x+1)^5 in G', so x = -1 is an extremum invisible to the second derivative test (way 5). Closest known: extrema of int_0^x f(t) dt with a double root of f (not an extremum). Different because: here the composition turns the double root into an odd power, so the point is an extremum.
blueprint_concepts: Maxima and minima of a function defined by a definite integral
Maxima & Minima: First & Second Derivative Tests

concept_use.Maxima and minima of a function defined: G(x) is defined by a definite integral with variable upper limit x^2 + 2x; its extrema come from the sign of G'.
concept_use.Maxima & Minima: First & Second Derivati: The first derivative test classifies all three points; the second derivative test fails at x = -1 (G''(-1) = 0) because of the fifth power.

stem_review: Read as a student: G has domain/codomain; 'points of local extremum' means x-values. Signs of G' checked numerically around -3, -1, 1. Answer -3, a negative integer as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Rewrite G' = 2(x+1)^5(x+3)(x-1)e^{(x^2+2x)^2} and use the first derivative test at x = -1.
justification: Two linked ideas: chain rule with the Newton-Leibniz rule exposing a composite factor, and a point where the second derivative test fails but the first succeeds; numerical answer. Lighter than 2021-P2-Q9 (L4, parity of exponents decides extrema) but the same kind of idea; L3.
